notes: 46,431 active address points with unit numbers for the whole town, updated daily; the core of an address import (tracked as ca/on/milton/addresses).
66 vertical-control benchmarks with elevations and descriptions; OSM can hold survey points but few mappers want them.
456 on-road bike lane segments with surface and lighting; a signed network OSM often lacks as cycleway=lane tags on roads.
35,527 footprints, mostly bare outlines with empty height fields; a gap fill wherever OSM lacks Milton buildings.
45 road works from the 2022 capital programme; operational and planned work, not ground truth.
374 development application areas; a planning process record, not features on the ground.
5 fire stations with names and addresses; small check for amenity=fire_station, which OSM usually has.
Official names and extents for 3 hamlets, which OSM usually has only as place nodes; small layer.
978 designated heritage properties with by-law, date and significance; heritage tags OSM is usually missing in bulk.
Single town boundary polygon; OSM already carries the municipal boundary, authority is the province.
Official names and extents for 26 neighbourhoods, usable as place=neighbourhood areas OSM usually lacks.
166 sports fields and courts with names, lighting, fencing and bleachers; attributes OSM is usually missing on pitches.
57 town parking lots with names, capacity and accessible spaces; capacity and names are the gain over traced lots.
Official names and classification for 93 parks, which OSM often has as unnamed or loosely traced leisure=park areas.
38 public artworks with names, artists, materials and year; tourism=artwork detail OSM rarely has.
1,057 rail segments with length only; OSM usually has the rail lines already.
3,294 centrelines with names, speed limits, lanes, oneway and address ranges; maxspeed and lanes are a gain, geometry OSM has.
36 schools with type, name and address; a gap check for amenity=school, which OSM usually has.
5,256 sidewalk segments with surface and lighting; OSM traces sidewalks from imagery, so a gap check at most.
19 town facilities with names and types; OSM usually has community centres and town buildings already.
2,107 trail segments with surface and lighting but no names; surface tags and a gap check against OSM paths.
4 ward polygons with names, usable as boundary=political areas.
17 town-owned wifi locations at named facilities; internet_access=wlan tags OSM usually lacks, small layer.
Rural zoning is a legal designation, not ground truth.
